definition.name: Capture two ordinary clients and observe actual compiler imports

steps.name: Prepare only the normal captured compiler boundary and pinned binding tool
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
python3 tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-http-tools"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-http-tools" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Fetch the frozen native producer source for exact verification
Check unchanged clients and exact source and executable-input refusal controls
Authenticate existing Wasmtime48.0.7 products without building a host
Capture and compile one developer-owned crate and retain actual imports without HTTP pass credit
Retain bounded public input and original build observations including failures
